description:
BEHIND THE BALLET WITH ELIZABETH KAYE, ABT's Dance Historian

The second installment of our 2026 Fall Season BEHIND THE BALLET is up with three pieces in our program NEOCLASSICAL WORKS; BIRTHDAY OFFERING by Frederick Ashton, Kyle Abraham's MERCURIAL SON, and BALLET IMPERIAL by George Balanchine.

BEHIND THE BALLET WITH ELIZABETH KAYE, a series of talks with ABT's Dance Historian, renowned ballet lecturer, and New York Times #1 best-selling author.
